pages.title: Prime Number Ore
pages.text: Axiom stone threaded with veins that appear only at prime positions - never at a composite one, and never in a pattern I can predict. It feels slightly irregular, like counting with a missing beat. The ore is rarer deeper down.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I mined along a seam in axiom stone and found the veins only at prime intervals. The ore held numbers that could not be divided, and I kept every piece.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Platonic Realm (mine it for its drop).
